summary: integrations post-slack-settings sends exactly the fields the caller passed: --channel and --notify-events are typed flags, a flag that was not passed is not sent (the API keeps the stored value), an explicit empty value (--notify-events "" or --notify-events=, --channel "") reaches the wire as [] / "" (clear), and --stdin passes the body through untouched so a non-list notifyEvents gets the API's 400.
reason: The live POST /integrations/slack/settings distinguishes an omitted notifyEvents (keep) from [] (turn every alert group off) from a non-array (400), but the catalog spec typed this body as an untyped object, so the printed command offered only --stdin. Sending the field only when the slice is non-empty, instead of when the flag was passed (Changed()), silently turns a clear into a keep. spec.yaml carries the live typed requestBody for this one operation only; a reprint must re-fetch the live spec rather than fall back to the untyped placeholder, and the parity test pins spec.yaml, tools-manifest.json and the command to the same typed body.
validated_outcome: Wire body is exactly the flags passed ({}, {channel}, {notifyEvents:[]} for an explicit empty value, both); --stdin bodies including a non-array notifyEvents reach the API unchanged; spec.yaml, tools-manifest.json and the command flags agree on the typed body; go build, go vet and the focused internal/cli tests pass. Ported from the creator's private print (ptaramona/conduyt-crm-cli 45ae027, PR #1, Codex approved).
